script: const c = new LRUCache(2); return c.get(1);
const c = new LRUCache(2); c.put(1, 10); return c.get(1);

description: get returns -1 after key is evicted by overflow
script: const c = new LRUCache(2); c.put(1, 1); c.put(2, 2); c.put(3, 3); return c.get(1);
const c = new LRUCache(2); c.put(1, 1); c.put(2, 2); c.put(3, 3); return c.get(3);

description: get promotes key — accessed key survives a subsequent eviction
script: const c = new LRUCache(2); c.put(1, 1); c.put(2, 2); c.get(1); c.put(3, 3); return c.get(1);

description: get promotes key — unaccessed key is evicted instead
script: const c = new LRUCache(2); c.put(1, 1); c.put(2, 2); c.get(1); c.put(3, 3); return c.get(2);
const c = new LRUCache(2); c.put(1,1); c.put(2,2); const r1=c.get(1); c.put(3,3); const r2=c.get(2); c.put(4,4); const r3=c.get(1); const r4=c.get(3); const r5=c.get(4); return [r1,r2,r3,r4,r5];

description: put on existing key updates value and promotes to MRU
script: const c = new LRUCache(2); c.put(1, 1); c.put(2, 2); c.put(1, 10); c.put(3, 3); return [c.get(1), c.get(2), c.get(3)];

description: capacity-1 cache evicts immediately on second put
script: const c = new LRUCache(1); c.put(1, 1); c.put(2, 2); return [c.get(1), c.get(2)];

description: large sequence maintains correct LRU order throughout
script: const c = new LRUCache(3); c.put(1,1); c.put(2,2); c.put(3,3); c.get(1); c.put(4,4); const r1=c.get(2); c.get(3); c.get(1); c.put(5,5); const r2=c.get(4); return [r1, r2];
